research.notes: ProPublica lists the legal name as 'Oakland Tech Exchange' (EIN 92-2199377, exemption issued 2023); the organization operates publicly as 'Tech Exchange'. Address is the mailing address shown on the website footer. OUSD's Home Technology Access page (https://www.ousd.org/familycentral/home-technology-access) names Tech Exchange as a partner, used only as an identity signal.

profile.summary: Tech Exchange is an Oakland-based nonprofit that provides refurbished computers, digital skills training, affordable internet access and tech support to Bay Area families and schools. It also runs youth workforce and internship programs and offers e-waste and equipment-reuse services.

review.notes: Tech Exchange (formerly Oakland Tech Exchange West / OTX) is an Oakland nonprofit running Serve2STEM youth internship and workforce programs, consistent with an OUSD ECCCO internship MOU in Oakland.
